description: This file defines the WebShoppingCart class, which extends the ShoppingCart class to add web-specific functionality related to user session and request handling within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages user session data, locale, currency, and WebSite context during shopping cart operations.

classes.name: WebShoppingCart
classes.description: This class extends ShoppingCart to incorporate web-session specific features, initializing cart details based on HTTP request parameters and session attributes for use within the web layer of OFBiz.

methods.name: WebShoppingCart(HttpServletRequest, Locale, String)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shopping cart with request data, locale, and currency; sets user login context and party IDs based on session attributes.

methods.name: WebShoppingCart(HttpServletRequest)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes locale and currency from request attributes.

methods.name: WebShoppingCart(ShoppingCart)
methods.description: Copy constructor that clones an existing ShoppingCart object.

calls: super(LocalDispatcher, String, String, Locale, String, String, String)
